issue.title: Fix error massage for unknown value type

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Fixes confusing error message when unknown value type is specified in a terms
aggregation. Adds support for parsing "numeric" and "number" value types.

Fixes #55727
